	[*] Removed text to speech. I'll replace this with voice acting as soon as possible.
	
	[*] Removed the script that walked the player to the first quest. Once it's fixed up, I'll add it back.
	
	[*] Removed long-press keys in favor of unique keys for each action. This will prevent some of the strange input issues that were reported.

	[*] Removed controller support until long-press keys are fixed.

	[*] Removed footstep sounds until I have better sound files. 

	[*] Removed AI audio until it can be managed through a better system.

	[*] Blocked terraforming around cities.

        [*] Setup a new character creation system.

	[*] Setup improved spawn positions for the AI in the Prologue. This should fix some of the clipping issues.

	[*] Setup Save/Load for destroyed foliage.

	[*] Dr. Marx has become a boss that you need to fight.

	[*] Updated guide icons.

	[*] Updated the cloud sim/planet atmospheres, but they are extremely heavy at the moment.

	[*] Optimized networking.

	[*] Added EULA and game agreement.
	
	[*] Added credits.
	
	[*] Added benchmark system.
	
	[*] Added a scoreboard.
	
	[*] Added a lobby system.

	[*] Added Conversation system to replace text to speech.

	[*] Added Companion Influence System.

	[*] Added a function to block enemy spawners when a player places a building near one.
	
	[*] Added projectiles that explode after a certain number of hits.
		
	[*] Added a needle pistol.
		
	[*] Added improved Idle NPC interactions (random move to, random conversations, greeting the player when they walk by, etc...).
        
	[*] Added a pure sandbox map.
	
	[*] Added Telescopes.
		
	[*] Added resource deposits. These are not the same as the foliage that can be harvested with tools. These deposits contain large amounts of multiple resource types.

	[*] Added a new quest after you gather your access pass.
	
	[*] Added a new quest and boss after you defuse the bomb in the Engineering level.

	[*] Added bots for multiplayer matches.

	[*] Added options to copy loadouts between game modes.

	[*] Added the sanity system back to the game.
		
	[*] Added game mode filters.
	
	[*] Added zooming for third-person camera and scopes.
	
	[*] Added over 50 game options. More coming soon. Some options are hidden for certain game modes.
	
	[*] Added more AI models.

	[*] Added 'suicide bomber' AI.
	
	[*] Added a job system for companions.
	
	[*] Added a script to run random attacks on base terminals.
	
	[*] Added a script for random supply drops in open world levels.
	
	[*] Added some more stages to the tutorial.

	[*] Testing a fix for random enemy spawners in the Prologue.
	
	[*] Fixed an issue that made the player fall through the floor in the sandbox.
	
	[*] Fixed the prone camera.

	[*] Fixed lag when shooting guns.

	[*] Fixed floating buildings.

	[*] Fixed scenario reward text.
	
	[*] Fixed an issue that started the Season 1 quest in the sandbox.
	
	[*] Fixed issues that made the player start under the world.
	
	[*] Fixed issues that started quests before the level had finished loading.
	
	[*] Fixed an issue that cleared prefab build parts.
	
	[*] Fixed some broken build part models. There are still some that need adjusting.
	
	[*] Fixed some issues with the tutorial.
	
	[*] Fixed an issue that made the 3D ammo display backward.

	[*] Fixed an issue that cleared build parts after the first part is placed making it annoying to chain multiple parts together.
	
	[*] Fixed an issue that offset ADS camera too far to the right.

	[*] Fixed an issue that lets you select items in the in-game loadouts screen.

	[*] Fixed an issue that made scope materials darken the entire scope.
	
	[*] Fixed the scope alignment on the rattlesnake and Kraken.
	
	[*] Fixed lag when shooting guns.	

[/list]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES:[/h1]
[list]

	[*] The text for the new dialogue system is a rough draft. I will be updating it later. This update needed to come out before I could finish it.
		
	[*] Alt Tabbing will clear focus for your mouse. If you hold alt-tab and double click on the game screen to return it will resolve the issue. I'll have this fixed as soon as possible, but it looks like it might be an engine issue from what I've seen on the forums.

	[*] Boss fights are kinda lame. I'll be adding some cool intro FX/Cinematics later on.

	[*] Abilities are still W.I.P. please contact me at the support email to let me know what issues you have!

	[*] Entering your save game name can take a little time as the system goes through and ensures there are no duplicates. This only seems to happen if you create dozens of save games. 

	[*] Some modules are using duplicate models. This won't change the functionality at all and I'm in the process of designing unique models for them. 

	[*] In-game loadout selection does not work.

	[*] Shadows are bad.

	[*] Pink triangle appears on the screen when starting a new game or respawning.

	[*] Fix spelling/grammar and placeholder text.

	[*] Some menus still create layers that block input.

[/list]

notes.title: Day Zero 1.1.0
notes.content:
CHANGES::

	- *MAJOR CHANGE* Completely revamped tutorial.
	- *MAJOR CHANGE* Removed Space Defender in v 1.1
	- *MAJOR CHANGE* Removed old method to travel to planets in v 1.1
	- Changed to physical lighting.
	- Added planet rotation to simulate day/night cycle.
	- Changed flat worlds to sphere worlds in campaign.
	- Added option to return to old setup if you prefer. Click the logo in the main menu to switch!
	- Added a small drone enemy.
	- Optimized stat list. This should improve load times.
	- Updated character ability animations.
	- Added the full Nexus moon-ship to The Nexus map.
	- Added a ship hangar to The Nexus.

	- Removed the Harbinger from The Nexus map. This should reduce load times for The Nexus.
	- Implemented Zero G Movement.
	- Implemented Custom Gravity Vector for moving on planets.
	- Changed the ramp for the Harbinger.
	- Increased content densities.
	- Reduced flight speed.
	- Character creation menu has been removed and will be revamped in a later update.
	- Intro sequence has been removed and will be revamped in a later update.

FIXES::

	- Fixed an issue with the loading screen reversing progress.
	- Fixed an issue that froze crafting queue after canceling an item.
	- Fixed an issue that froze crafting queue after queuing multiple items.
	- Fixed an issue with save games loading buildings in ground. 
	- Fixed an issue where jumping while flying would cancel flight instead of moving player up.
	- Fixed an issue where crouching while jumping would cancel flight instead of moving player down.
	- Fixed an issue that loaded your Personal Quarters at the wrong offset when loading a save game in The Nexus.
	- Fixed an issue that skipped game agreement if user selected continue and do not show again option.
	- Fixed an issue that caused buttons to start with the wrong color in the main menu.
	- Fixed an issue that caused AI to get stuck and stop attacking.
	- Fixed an issue that caused Game Mode Description to start with text "Text Block".
	- Fixed an issue that allowed the player to fall through world when loading game outside of a building.
	- Fixed an issue that made player use wrong hand when drinking and eating.
	- Fixed issues with input when using chat system.
	- Fixed issues with input when using containers.

KNOWN ISSUES:: 

	- Removing an attachment will still allow you to drag the attachment icon throwing an error notification while adding an invalid item to your inventory.
	- Certain weapons have attachments that should not have attachments.
	- Removing an attachment from pistol can cause the pistol to be removed from your hotbar and added to your inventory.
	- Switching from weapons while they are held could add them back to your inventory.
	- Player isn't getting set to prone speed while going prone.
	- Moving on planets is tough with planets that have high gravity.
	- Cheats don't work.
	- Foundations can't be placed on planets. Modules still work.
	- Tutorial isn't showing crafting menu.
	- AI stand still for a long time before they start moving.
		+ This issue has been located and will be resolved in the next update. 
	- Headlooking doesn't work when flying space craft in first person.
	- Gravity vector can be thrown off depending on your speed. 
		+ This issue has been located and will be resolved in the next update. 
		+ To avoid this issue, stay toward the northern/southern pole of planets. 
	- Grass and trees might bounce up and down when running on large planets.
	- Loading screen might revert back to main menu loading screen if travelling from sandbox to campaign. 
		+ This issue has been located and will be resolved in the next update.

UP NEXT::

	- More content (space stations, more spooky stuff, random encounters, etc...).
	- Vehicle tutorials.
	- Crew management tutorials.
	- Planet/Nexus management tutorials.
	- Star/Gas giant harvesting.
	- Planetary orbit simulations.
	- Custom jobs for crew members.
	- "Citizen" npcs
	- Custom crew commands.
	- Command menu.
	- Diplomacy Simulation.
	- RTS components (basic unit selection, buildings, AI).
	- Custom solar systems.
	- Changing intro character to make it more obvious that you're an alien.	
	- More vehicles. NOTE::This might get pushed to next update.

NOTES::

	- Because of the changes, the Campaign objectives for Season 0 and Season 1 will change. 
	- Because of the changes, your save data will be invalidated in v 1.1.
	- Right now most of the planets, but I plan on updating them as we get closer to Season 2.
	- You can travel to other planets by entering a ship using the ship hangar.
	- Then press your Auto Run key to view your system map.
	- Each planet has an "atmosphere" that dictates weather/clouds/etc, but all lighting effects come directly from the star.
	- Space combat is now a seamless part of the Campaign!
	- I understand that the changes seem sudden, but this was my plan from day one. The space elements of the game will have no impact on the horror elements that I plan to add.

notes.title: 0.8.0 - RPG Elements!
notes.content:
0.8.0 is here! 

The new update brings some new RPG elements to the game that will help bring you closer to Day Zero's story-line and it's impact on the rest of the Universe.

The companion system has been revamped to make it easier for users to build their team and conquer the solar system. 

The Nexus is back with a ton of new rooms that contain NPCs waiting to be convinced to join your adventure!

NPCs will now have unique dialogue options and side quests that will give you the ability to unlock unique items, weapons and story options!

I've also updated the market system to make it easier to sort and browse items, and the new wallet system makes it easier for you to track your assets and different currency types.

The racing system is back with multiple tiers and prizes! 

0.9.0 will bring a lot of bug fixes, adjustments, and a ton of new items! This will roll us into the 1.0.0 update that will include all of the Campaign elements!

notes.title: 0.6.0 - Exploration & Diplomacy Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This new update includes improvements to the exploration and diplomacy system.

I've added an encoded notes system that will contain journal entries from different characters. Each note is encrypted with a series of unique keys. Collect all of the keys to unlock the notes!

The diplomacy system includes passive quests that will give you unique rewards as well as a new UI for viewing and managing your relations.

You'll also see some minor bug fixes and adjustments, new items and more improvements to the planet generation algorithm.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update 0.0.1 - Modular Weapons!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thank you so much for the support and feedback!
